correctness.rationale: Exact integer-redundancy Zak diagonalization is classical; a two-sided residue-class geometric series yields the stated rational multiplier. On 0<=x<=1, U=H_q(r^(2x)+r^(2-2x)) is strictly convex and satisfies U>=2qt by AM-GM, forcing strict negativity of the multiplier y-derivative. Boundary evaluations give the sharp A/B and their exact locations, positivity follows from strict q-term AM-GM, and the large-q limit follows from convergence of a geometric sum. Direct truncated Zak-series CHECK.py checked independent values for 9 parameter pairs and 289 assertions in total, including non-extreme points. Its finite tests do not substitute for the analytic proof.
